clusters.name: Installed Audio DSP & Control
clusters.description: These companies make the digital signal processors, amplifiers, and networked audio hardware that drive live sound, conferencing, and commercial installed-audio systems.

clusters.name: AI-Powered Hearing Aids
clusters.description: These companies manufacture finished hearing aids, OTC hearing devices, and related hearables as end products for consumers and patients.

clusters.name: On-Device Voice Recognition
clusters.description: These organizations develop on-device speech recognition, voice front-end, and paralinguistic analysis models for embedded and mobile hardware.

clusters.name: Guitar Amps & Amp Modelers
clusters.description: These companies build digital modeling amplifiers, effects pedals, and multi-effects processors that simulate guitar/bass amp and pedal tones for musicians.

clusters.name: Hi-Fi Loudspeaker Brands
clusters.description: These companies design, manufacture, and sell finished loudspeaker systems and related audio equipment (home speakers, headphones, car audio) that consumers and installers buy and use directly.

clusters.name: Audio Amplifier & Converter ICs
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture semiconductor chips—amplifiers, converters, codecs, and DSPs—that power audio functions in other companies' consumer, automotive, and professional devices.

clusters.name: Mixing & Mastering Plugins
clusters.description: These companies develop digital audio workstations and the mixing, mastering, and restoration plugins musicians and engineers use to produce music.

clusters.name: Headphones & Bluetooth Speakers
clusters.description: These companies make and sell finished consumer headphones, earbuds, and home/portable speakers to end users.

clusters.name: Networked Pro Audio Interfaces
clusters.description: These companies build audio-over-IP networking technology and the interfaces/converters that connect to it for broadcast, live sound, and install markets.

clusters.name: Immersive Venue Sound Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture loudspeakers, amplifiers, and processors for fixed installation and live sound reinforcement in venues such as theaters, stadiums, and performance spaces.

clusters.name: Studio Monitor Makers
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture loudspeakers — spanning professional install sound, live sound reinforcement, studio monitors, and home audio — sold as finished hardware to venues, studios, and consumers.

clusters.name: Audio Codec Standards & Licensing
clusters.description: These entities develop, standardize, or license audio codecs and related IP (plus certification and patent pooling) that device makers build into their products.

clusters.name: Professional Power Amplifiers
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture power amplifiers and amplifier modules for professional installed and live sound systems.

clusters.name: Speech Recognition & TTS APIs
clusters.description: Members build speech recognition, synthesis, and voice-agent AI models/APIs sold to developers building voice-enabled applications.

clusters.name: Room Correction Software
clusters.description: These companies develop algorithms, simulation tools, and measurement systems used to model, test, and correct how sound behaves in rooms, vehicles, and loudspeaker/headphone systems.

clusters.name: Speech & Audio Datasets
clusters.description: These organizations collect, license, or crowdsource audio and speech recordings used to train and evaluate AI voice and sound models.

clusters.name: Speech Synthesis & Voice Cloning
clusters.description: These companies develop AI models and platforms for generating, cloning, and converting synthetic speech and voices.

clusters.name: Hi-Fi Amplifiers & DACs
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture premium home audio electronics—amplifiers, DACs, streamers, turntables, and headphone amps—for audiophile consumers.

clusters.name: Acoustic Test & Measurement Equipment
clusters.description: These companies build audio analyzers, measurement microphones, and transducer test systems used to validate acoustic and voice performance.

clusters.name: MEMS Microphone Suppliers
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture MEMS microphone components sold into smartphones, wearables, automotive, and IoT devices for other manufacturers' end products.

clusters.name: Mixers & Live Sound Gear
clusters.description: These companies manufacture mixing consoles, microphones, outboard processors, and related gear for live sound installation and professional studio recording.

clusters.name: Studio Microphone Manufacturers
clusters.description: These companies design and build professional condenser, dynamic, and ribbon microphones for studio recording, live sound, and broadcast use.

clusters.name: Wireless & Creator Microphones
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture microphones and wireless audio systems (mics, in-ear monitors, RF transmission) for live sound, broadcast, and content creation.

clusters.name: Wireless Home Audio Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture finished smart speakers, home audio systems, and related consumer audio hardware sold directly to consumers.

clusters.name: Voice Agent Platforms
clusters.description: These companies build conversational AI systems that combine speech recognition, language understanding, and voice synthesis into real-time speech-to-speech agents.

clusters.name: Synthesizers & Drum Machines
clusters.description: These companies build hardware synthesizers, drum machines, modular systems, and instrument-modeling gear that musicians buy and play directly.

clusters.name: AI Stem Separation & Denoising
clusters.description: These companies build AI-driven software (often SaaS or plugins) that isolates, cleans, or masters audio tracks for musicians, podcasters, and call/meeting participants.

clusters.name: True Wireless Earbud Brands
clusters.description: These companies make and sell finished consumer headphones, earbuds, and hearables (often with ANC and spatial audio features) to end users.

clusters.name: Conferencing Microphones & Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture microphones, speakerphones, headsets, and room systems built specifically for business video/audio conferencing and unified communications.

clusters.name: Audiophile Home Loudspeakers
clusters.description: These companies design and build finished loudspeakers and drivers primarily for home, hi-fi, and consumer audio use.

clusters.name: Hearing Aid & Implant Manufacturing
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture hearing aids, cochlear implants, and related assistive hearing devices for people with hearing loss.

clusters.name: Edge Audio AI Silicon
clusters.description: These companies design always-on, low-power chips and licensable DSP/NPU cores that run on-device audio and voice AI inference in embedded and wearable products.

clusters.name: Live & Broadcast Mixing Consoles
clusters.description: These companies build mixing consoles and networked audio infrastructure for live sound, broadcast, and install applications.

clusters.name: Studio Outboard & Interfaces
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture analog/digital mixing consoles, outboard processors, and audio interfaces for professional recording and broadcast studios.

clusters.name: Custom In-Ear Monitors
clusters.description: Members design and manufacture finished headphones, custom in-ear monitors, and related hearing/hearables products sold directly to musicians, audiophiles, and consumers.

clusters.name: Public Address & Paging Systems
clusters.description: These companies manufacture finished PA, paging, intercom, and networked conferencing audio hardware for schools, transportation hubs, and other public/commercial venues.

clusters.name: Automotive Audio Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and supply factory-installed and aftermarket car audio systems, from mass-market OEM electronics to premium branded in-vehicle sound.

clusters.name: Spatial Audio Technology
clusters.description: These companies develop, license, or implement spatial/immersive audio formats and algorithms used across headphones, speakers, games, and personalization.

clusters.name: Home Theater & Custom Installation
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture speakers, amplifiers, receivers, and processors sold as finished products for home theater and custom-installation audio markets.

clusters.name: Hearing Loop & Assistive Listening Systems
clusters.description: These companies build assistive listening systems and hearing loops that transmit audio wirelessly to hearing aids and venue audiences.

clusters.name: Touring Loudspeaker Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and build finished loudspeaker systems and amplification for live sound reinforcement and permanent installation.

clusters.name: DSP Guitar Effects Pedals
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture instrument effects pedals and processors that musicians use to shape guitar, bass, and other instrument tones.

clusters.name: Bluetooth Audio SoC Makers
clusters.description: These companies design wireless audio chips and codec IP for Bluetooth earbuds, headsets, and wearable devices.

clusters.name: OTC Hearing Device Makers
clusters.description: These companies manufacture and sell finished over-the-counter and traditional hearing aids directly to consumers.

clusters.name: Smart & Personalized Hearables
clusters.description: These companies design and sell finished headphones, earbuds, and hearable devices—including OTC hearing and personalized-hearing variants—directly to consumers.

clusters.name: Digital Audio Workstations
clusters.description: These companies build DAW software, audio interfaces, plugins, and instrument-modeling effects used by musicians and producers to record, mix, and perform music.

clusters.name: Boutique Guitar Pedals
clusters.description: These companies design and manufacture guitar/instrument effects pedals and related signal-processing hardware for musicians.

clusters.name: PA Sound Reinforcement Systems
clusters.description: These companies design and build pro audio hardware—amplifiers, mixing consoles, loudspeakers, and outboard processors—for live sound and installation markets.

clusters.name: Generative Music AI
clusters.description: These companies build AI models and platforms that generate original music, sound effects, or audio from text, video, or other prompts.

tag_info.mems_microphones: Designs or manufactures MEMS microphones for phones, earbuds, laptops, and other devices
tag_info.pro_studio_microphones: Makes professional, studio, broadcast, or live-performance microphones
tag_info.speaker_drivers: Makes loudspeaker drivers, microspeakers, or speaker modules for products
tag_info.solid_state_speakers: Develops MEMS or other solid-state speakers
tag_info.receivers_bone_conduction: Makes hearing-aid receivers, balanced-armature drivers, or bone-conduction transducers
tag_info.vibration_voice_pickup: Makes vibration or accelerometer sensors used to pick up the wearer's voice
tag_info.audio_converters_codecs: Designs audio ADC, DAC, or audio codec chips
tag_info.audio_amplifiers: Designs audio amplifier chips, including class-D and smart amplifiers with speaker protection
tag_info.audio_dsp_chips: Designs dedicated audio digital signal processor chips
tag_info.dsp_npu_ip_cores: Licenses DSP or neural-processing IP cores that chipmakers embed for audio and voice
tag_info.application_socs_audio: Designs application processors or SoCs with integrated audio subsystems
tag_info.wireless_audio_socs: Designs Bluetooth or wireless audio SoCs for earbuds, headphones, and speakers
tag_info.always_on_audio_ai_chips: Designs ultra-low-power always-on or edge AI processors for voice and audio, including analog, in-memory, or neuromorphic audio compute
tag_info.wireless_audio_standards: Develops or governs wireless audio standards such as Bluetooth LE Audio, Auracast, or Wi-Fi audio
tag_info.audio_codec_licensing: Develops and licenses audio compression codecs or formats
tag_info.networked_pro_audio: Provides audio-over-IP or networked audio technology for professional systems
tag_info.automotive_audio_networking: Provides in-vehicle audio bus or automotive audio networking technology
tag_info.hearing_assistive_links: Provides connectivity for hearing aids and assistive listening such as ASHA, telecoil, or broadcast audio
tag_info.streaming_protocols: Develops consumer audio streaming or real-time voice transport protocols
tag_info.voice_front_end: Develops voice front-end software: echo cancellation, beamforming, or noise suppression for calls and voice control
tag_info.active_noise_cancellation: Develops active noise cancellation and transparency technology for headphones
tag_info.spatial_immersive_audio: Develops spatial or immersive audio formats, renderers, or technology
tag_info.personalized_hearing_profiles: Develops personalized HRTF or hearing-profile audio personalization, including HRTFs estimated from photos or calibration
tag_info.room_speaker_correction: Develops room acoustics or loudspeaker correction and tuning software
tag_info.automotive_sound_software: Develops in-car sound processing such as road noise cancellation, sound zones, or vehicle tuning
tag_info.loudness_broadcast_processing: Develops loudness management or broadcast audio processing
tag_info.game_audio_middleware: Develops game or interactive audio engines and middleware
tag_info.dsp_dev_frameworks: Provides frameworks or tools for developing audio DSP software
tag_info.speech_recognition: Develops speech-to-text recognition models or services
tag_info.speech_synthesis_voice_cloning: Develops text-to-speech, voice synthesis, or voice cloning
tag_info.voice_agents_speech_to_speech: Develops real-time conversational voice agents or speech-to-speech models, including full-duplex dialogue models that listen while speaking and handle interruptions
tag_info.generative_music_sound: Develops AI that generates music or sound effects
tag_info.source_separation_enhancement: Develops AI source separation, stem extraction, or speech and audio enhancement
tag_info.sound_event_detection: Develops AI that detects sound events or classifies acoustic scenes
tag_info.contextual_audio: Builds devices or AI that perceive the acoustic world around the user (who is speaking, from where), infer intent, or selectively reshape what the user hears
tag_info.neural_audio_codecs: Develops neural audio codecs or audio tokenizers, for compression or as the token vocabulary of generative audio models
tag_info.on_device_audio_models: Develops compact speech or audio models built to run on-device: small ASR, distilled or quantized speech models for NPUs and edge hardware
tag_info.neural_dsp: Replaces classic audio DSP with neural networks: neural echo cancellation, beamforming, dereverberation, differentiable DSP, or neural speaker protection
tag_info.audio_video_generation: Develops AI that generates audio for video or jointly with video: video-to-audio Foley, AI sound effects for picture, or speech-driven lip-sync and facial animation
tag_info.generated_audio_evaluation: Develops metrics, benchmarks, or services that evaluate the quality of AI-generated or neurally coded audio
tag_info.music_analysis_transcription: Develops AI that transcribes or analyzes music: notes, chords, beats, structure, or playing technique, or attributes music to training data
tag_info.paralinguistic_analysis: Develops AI that reads how something is said rather than what: emotion, prosody, speaking style, or speaker traits
tag_info.audio_language_models: Develops audio-language or audio foundation models that reason about sound and speech
tag_info.industrial_acoustic_monitoring: Uses acoustic or vibration analysis to monitor industrial machines
tag_info.audio_identification_security: Provides audio fingerprinting, watermarking, provenance or signed capture, or synthetic-speech, deepfake, anti-spoofing, and voice-fraud detection
tag_info.embedded_audio_ml_tooling: Provides tools for building and deploying audio ML models on embedded devices
tag_info.mixing_consoles: Makes mixing consoles for live, studio, or broadcast
tag_info.audio_interfaces_converters: Makes audio interfaces or studio converters
tag_info.outboard_processors: Makes outboard studio processing hardware such as reverbs, compressors, or effects
tag_info.audio_plugins: Develops audio effect or instrument plugins
tag_info.install_live_sound: Makes installed or live sound systems, loudspeakers, or system DSP
tag_info.conferencing_audio: Makes conferencing audio products such as microphone arrays or meeting-room systems
tag_info.instrument_modeling_effects: Makes instrument amp modeling, effects pedals, or musical instrument processors
tag_info.audio_odm_manufacturing: Contract manufactures or designs audio products for other brands
tag_info.smart_speakers_home_audio: Makes smart speakers, home audio, or hi-fi products
tag_info.otc_hearing_devices: Makes over-the-counter hearing devices or hearing features in consumer earbuds
tag_info.cochlear_implants: Makes cochlear implants or implantable hearing systems
tag_info.automotive_audio_systems: Supplies complete automotive audio systems to carmakers
tag_info.audio_analyzers: Makes audio analyzers and electroacoustic test systems
tag_info.transducer_measurement: Makes loudspeaker or transducer measurement systems
tag_info.acoustic_test_psychoacoustics: Provides acoustic test equipment, measurement microphones, or psychoacoustic analysis
tag_info.acoustic_chambers: Builds anechoic chambers or acoustic test facilities
tag_info.acoustic_simulation: Provides acoustic or room simulation software, including synthetic audio training data
tag_info.audio_standards_bodies: Standards body or industry association that defines audio standards
tag_info.audio_patent_licensing: Runs audio patent pools or licenses audio patents and technology
tag_info.audio_certification: Runs an audio product certification or logo program
tag_info.audio_datasets: Provides audio or speech datasets or audio data-collection services
tag_info.medical_acoustics: Applies audio sensing to medicine, such as digital stethoscopes or cough and voice biomarkers
tag_info.gunshot_public_safety: Provides gunshot detection or acoustic public-safety systems
tag_info.ultrasonic_sensing: Uses ultrasound for presence, gesture, or proximity sensing
tag_info.semiconductor_company: Company whose main business is designing or making chips
tag_info.big_tech_platform: Large technology platform company (e.g. Apple, Google, Amazon, Meta, Samsung, Microsoft)
